picks.why: Applied Materials just beat Q4 estimates on AI demand with 53% revenue growth and a 33% operating margin at 15.8x forward earnings, 48% off its high. It is a picks-and-shovels play on the demand thesis that does not depend on which chip designer wins after Huang's exit.
picks.risk: Tighter China export controls after the Nvidia smuggling reports would cut a large share of equipment sales.

picks.why: Sandisk trades at 3.2x forward earnings with an 8% FCF yield and 73% operating margin, still 60% off its high despite a week-long memory bounce. The watchlist has no memory name, and the price limits the downside if the shortage fades.
picks.risk: If the memory shortage is the cycle peak, earnings collapse and the low P/E is a value trap.

passed_on.reason: Same memory exposure as SNDK at a higher multiple and only 2% FCF yield; avoid two picks from one segment.
